name: Replit Agent
official_status_notes: Agent builds apps through chat on Replit (Agent v2+); built-in DB, auth, deployments, testing; agent tests its own work (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free tier; paid plans include agent usage (Core/Pro).
best_for: Non-experts and founders who want chat-to-app with hosting included.
strengths: All-in-one (IDE + DB + auth + hosting), autonomous agent, browser test loop.
weaknesses: Not a traditional coding workflow; lock-in to Replit.
